items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders. Worked off to side Thu.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-W1 exit; Harbaugh day-to-day but trajectory negative
items.implication: Sit if owned; boost Quentin Johnston as primary beneficiary

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR (wrist). If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Aggravated W1 issue; consecutive misses vs Saints
items.implication: GTD or OUT risk; Bateman flex if limited options; avoid deeper BAL WRs
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for remaining WRs/TE Andrews

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wed practice (missed 5 games on hammy in 2024); DNP Thu; MRI pending. Ran 37/42 routes W1. Status in jeopardy vs CIN.
items.why: Hamstring pull history + practice miss; Schefter sources say not believed serious but jeopardy
items.implication: Monitor MRI/Fri practice; if OUT, elevate Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel and Dalton Schultz

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' (ankle); full participant prior. Unclear how much he eats into Rhamondre Stevenson, but Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown IR. Nice matchups ahead.
items.why: Self-reported ready + practice full; timing with Brown absence
items.implication: Flex upside; monitor split vs Stevenson (low-end RB2/Flex)
items.opportunity: Explosive plays + favorable slate PIT-JAX-BUF etc pre-bye

items.text: Brock Bowers DNP again (knee surgery last week); yet to practice. Kubiak hopes for practice this week but OUT risk high vs LAC.
items.why: No practice since surgery; consecutive misses
items.implication: If OUT, Michael Mayer fringe TE1; stash Bowers ROS

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 24% tgt share (tied lead, 2nd-highest career). IND just gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: Massive W1 usage in Chiefs debut + soft run matchup
items.implication: Must-start RB1; elite ROS outlook if healthy

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in Kubiak debut (tied Bijan lead). 19% tgt share last 10; 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Injury scare overreaction.
items.why: Elite util + consistent volume under new OC
items.implication: Strong RB start @ LAC; buy if faded

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE (back in after tough W1): 27% tgt/13.7 aDOT/3 deep looks W1. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last yr.
items.why: Usage bounce + soft secondary matchup @ TEN

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% tgt share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB RZ touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Expanded role vs Gainwell + favorable run D
items.implication: RB start vs CLE; volume secure

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career Wentz games. CHI D soft (10+ YPT to CAR WRs).
items.implication: WR1 lock @ CHI even if Murray returns later

items.text: Mike Evans LOVE: WR14 util W1, 25% RZ tgts, led SF routes. MIA corners ranked 32nd preseason.
items.why: Strong debut usage + elite matchup vs MIA

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1; 69% fantasy pts air. Kamara expected back squeezes further; NO underdogs @ BAL not run script.
items.implication: Sit/flex only; Miller beneficiary if Kamara limited
items.conflict: ETR notes Kamara return reverses Miller

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs. Bourne debut further muddies.
items.why: Anemic usage + tough matchup + added competition
items.implication: Sit; prefer other ARI options or stashes in 10-team

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE: 69% routes (higher than any 2025 game), 77% snaps (highest since W9 2024). DET allowed 27 TE pts. Top-5 util.
items.why: Expanded healthy role + soft TE matchup vs DET
items.implication: TE1 start; breakout signal if sustained
